verdict.rationale: Spline is explicitly cloud-based and multiplayer 'from the ground up' with files living in Spline's cloud (spline-docs-2, spline-docs-30, spline-docs-34); the 'Self-Hosted' feature only exports a finished project's runtime/assets as a static ZIP for deployment, not the editor/core product itself (spline-docs-8, spline-docs-18, spline-docs-23). There is no evidence of an installable/self-hostable version of the Spline editing platform or its backend.
